def transform(grid):
    # Fill the grid with the repeating diagonal color sequence identified by the
    # parallel color stripes.
    seq = [6, 9, 8, 5]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [[seq[(c - r) % len(seq)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
